headline: Resolutions and budget authorizations for multiple Community Improvement Program funding amendments.
summary: The committee will consider resolutions amending the Community Improvement Program for several projects, including deferred maintenance, building demolition, the JFK Coliseum Chiller Plant, Wolfe Park Recreation Complex, and dental and health programs. It will also review related budget authorizations for these and other projects.
